title: The Understudy WIP
description: Work-in-progress build of The Understudy, a new playable character for Slay the Spire 2. Shared for friend testing. Requires BaseLib.
changeNote: v1.12.46: Reworked what each Timeline chapter unlocks so it matches the story it tells. 'Writing an End' now unlocks The Golden Bedroom - the event where you find the book it describes. The Lesson cards are spread across the chapters they belong to: the First with 'Taken', the Second with 'Nothing Like Him', the Final with 'Every Story has a Lesson'. Potions moved to 'Consumed' and relics to 'Dreamless'. No Common card, relic or potion is locked behind an epoch any more - Foreshadow, Orchestration, Melody and Safety Net are now available from the first run, as is My Own Lesson.
